devon: FYI canary 6371 (sable-liteq int8) shows ~5.5% funcall parse failures vs 0.2% fp32, concentrated on streaming toolcalls. :frowning:
maya: thanks. any raw chunk dumps?
devon: uploaded sample to INF-3400. snippet shows a NUL then RS between objects: `...}�{"name":"search",...}`
aj: that exact sequence will break our NDJSON parser. looks like tokenization/emit timing changed on int8 path.
ryan: short-term: a canary-only streaming sanitizer that normalizes lone NUL/RS to newline and buffers until a full top-level JSON is available. log every repair.
maya: pseudo patch: ```buf += chunk; buf = buf.replace('�','
').replace('','
'); while (has_object(buf)) emit(pop_object(buf));```
aj: add metric `struct_repair.count` and trace tag `repair=true` so we can quantify. keep prod strict.
devon: also need deterministic repro harness: I'll export chunk dumps with `--dump-chunks` and `--dump-tokens`.
ryan: will instrument tokenization snapshots in canary traces so we can map token->byte boundaries.
ops-bot: ticket INF-3400 created "sentinel-pad streaming repair + token-trace".
canary-bot: scheduled split canary 6371 at 10:30 PT tomorrow (50% sanitizer / 50% baseline).
